info.name: Rice To Meet You - API Routes
info.description: Postman collection for the Rice-To-Meet-You FastAPI backend. Recommended flow: create/login user for protected dataset CRUD, generate a city grid, assign grid metrics, run interpolation, view heatmap or mesh GeoJSON, then fetch/assign NWS weather when needed. Set baseUrl to your running API, for example http://127.0.0.1:8000.

exec: pm.test('created or already exists', function () { pm.expect([201, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
